COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY - RATE ORDER OF CALCULATIONS

This rate order applies to form CG 00 01 (Edition 04 13).

Step 1 - Base Loss Cost (ADD, BASE_LOSS_COST)
  Applicability: CG 00 01
  Source: ISO Advisory Loss Cost Filing, Rule 10.

Step 2 - Class Code Factor (MUL, ADJUSTED_BASE)
  Applicability: CG 00 01
  Source: Rate Manual Rule 100, Table A - Class Code Factors.
  Reference: see Rule 100 for factor values by class code.

Step 3 - Territory Factor (MUL, ADJUSTED_BASE)
  Applicability: CG 00 01
  Source: Rate Manual Rule 110, Table B - Territory Factors.

Step 4 - Minimum Premium (ADD, ADDITIONAL_COVERAGE)
  Applicability: CG 00 01
  Source: Rate Manual Rule 120 - Minimum Premium Schedule.
  Maximum credit rule: Rule 92 (credits cannot exceed 25%).
  Minimum premium rule: Rule 120.

COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY RATE MANUAL

Rule 100 - Class Code Factors
This rule governs the class code factor applied to the base loss cost.
FACTOR TABLE: pairs layout.
Key column: Class Code
Value column: Factor
Verbatim region:
Class Code | Factor
45190      | 1.00
49450      | 1.15
91111      | 1.32
99999      | 0.85

Rule 110 - Territory Factors
This rule governs territory multipliers applied after the class code adjustment.
FACTOR TABLE: pairs layout.
Key column: Territory Code
Value column: Factor
Verbatim region:
Territory | Factor
001        | 1.00
002        | 0.92
003        | 1.18

Rule 120 - Minimum Premium Schedule
The minimum annual premium for this coverage is $500 per policy.
SCALAR: Minimum Premium = 500
Form applicability: CG 00 01
Citation: Rule 120, Minimum Premium section.

Rule 92 - Maximum Credit Schedule
Total schedule credits shall not exceed 25% of the standard premium.
SCALAR: Maximum Credit Percentage = 0.25
Citation: Rule 92, Credit Limitation section.
